intent: Add portable typed BPMN multi-instance authoring, validation, serialization, import/update/reopen preservation, and matching MCP documentation.

findings.title: Imported expression shape was not reusable by update_element
findings.why_it_matters: get_element exposed an internal expression type field that the strict update_element schema rejected, preventing agents from reusing the returned multi-instance configuration.
evidence: readLoopExpression returned type while loopExpression in src/server/tools.ts accepts only body and language.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the public expression shape to body/language and always serialize it as bpmn:FormalExpression.

applied_fixes: Removed the internal type field from imported public properties and standardized authored/imported loop expressions as bpmn:FormalExpression.
learnings: No docs/solutions directory exists in this repository.
agent_native: Pass: multi-instance create/update is advertised through the MCP tool schema, returned by get_element, and documented with a copyable request shape.
verdict: Ready to merge after required gates pass
